//samplesDirectories: The directories that hold the sample documents. The test reads the samples of each one. If a test run holds more than one directory, the name of a sample starts with the name of its directory.
//excludeDirectories: Directory names that the test steps over. The name applies at each depth. Each name after 'attachments' belongs to the corpus; see the note at the end.
//checkedElements: The elements of the content check. An empty list checks all elements. See InvoiceElementRules.All.
//reportFile: The file for the report of the XML value coverage. Empty puts it in TestResults beside the solution file.
//corpus: The second directory is the corpus of ZUGFeRD (https://github.com/ZUGFeRD/corpus).
It holds documents of the practice. It doubles the number of the CII samples.
The corpus also holds documents that Pacioli does not read. excludeDirectories
UBL, PEPPOL   UBL documents. Pacioli reads UBL after phase 6 of the migration.
other         Holds one UBL document. Take this name out together with UBL.
fatturaPA     The Italian standard. It is not an EN 16931 invoice.
ZUGFeRDv1     ZUGFeRD 1.0. The parser reads ZUGFeRD 2.x only.
fail          Documents with an artificial error.
unstructured  A PDF file without an invoice in it.
